findings.summary: after_suite records revision 4c4d9fec but its cited log's header names 3a5fceb with 'worktree carries uncommitted node change', so the recorded revision cannot be reconciled against the log it points at.
The 'ruff delta 0 findings' and the 517 KB soup-count measurement are stated in artifacts but no log path in test_logs records either, so both are claimed rather than recorded.
_PlanDocumentParse.structural reconstructs the parser inline rather than extending _structural_spans at reckon/_plan_html.py:394, so one scan now has two construction sites that can drift.

The gate arms ran in the node worktree and a scratch extraction rather than on the all_debug partition the done-when named; both arms are single-process and under 20 s, so the deviation did not contend with peers.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py:136 asserts the actual parse count against a literal one and negative-control.log records 1 failed / 6 parses when the per-pass parse is restored, so the guard fails on the regression it names.
justifications.evidence: The gate at tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py:127 measures the done-when and negative-control.log shows it reddening, but the manifest's after_suite revision disagrees with after-arm.log's header and the ruff result at manifest.md:20 is claimed without a log.
justifications.fit: The added class at reckon/_plan_html.py:401 follows the module's private-helper idiom and names its mechanism rather than any plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_plan_html.py:2283 builds one _PlanDocumentParse and every pass at :2331, :2379, :2386 and :2365 reads it, so one landing's write parses the document once.
justifications.reuse: The parse-sharing capability is new, but reckon/_plan_html.py:424 rebuilds the parser inline instead of extending _structural_spans at :394, leaving two construction sites for one scan.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff (reckon/_plan_html.py, tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py, the landing fragment) is inside the declared write paths and nothing else changed.

negative_controls: Independently re-ran the base revision's writer (3a5fceb, extracted to a scratch tree) over the node test's fixture and payload: its output equals the test's EXPECTED literal byte for byte, so the byte-identity assertion is not a mirror of the head implementation.
reviewed_gate_rerun: PYTHONPATH=<node worktree> <root>/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q <node worktree>/tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py -> 3 passed in 1.71s

verdicts.call_sites: Production callers of write_state whose behaviour the change reaches were read: reckon/serve.py:3909, reckon/tags.py:130, reckon/archive.py:132, reckon/_store.py:1717, reckon/_store.py:2450 and reckon/_plan_html.py:2366; the signature is unchanged so none needs changing.
verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 3a5fceb; one commit 4c4d9fec adds the _PlanDocumentParse class and threads an optional parse through five private passes, moves the record splice ahead of the meta edits, adds a 150-line test, and adds a landing fragment.
verdicts.done_when: The done-when names a test that counts exactly one full parse and byte-identical output; tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py:127-139 counts document-sized soups and asserts one, and :141-142 compares against a literal EXPECTED, with the negative control at negative-control.log showing 1 failed under a restored per-pass parse.
verdicts.goal: The node goal is 'one landing's plan write parses its plan once'; reckon/_plan_html.py:401 adds _PlanDocumentParse and write_state (reckon/_plan_html.py:2283) builds one and hands it to every pass, which the gate measures as one document-sized soup.
verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, one commit, the gate command and six logs, a baseline arm with two setup errors attributed to a git-less extraction, and an after arm of 54 passed exit 0.
verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/_store.py, the node test, the landing fragment and a figure directory; the diff touches reckon/_plan_html.py, tests/test_a_plan_write_parses_its_plan_once.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-plan-write-parses-its-plan-once.html, all inside them.
